notes.title: Devlog 3
notes.content:
After a week of extensive experimentation, we’ve decided to make significant changes to the game’s progression system.

In a previous post, I mentioned that players were struggling to stay engaged with the late-game content, often dropping out early. To address this, we ran numerous tests and pinpointed the issue: the game’s pacing.

The spawn and portal rooms at the beginning and end of each node weren’t contributing meaningfully to the experience, so we’ve decided to remove them from all combat nodes. Additionally, we’re breaking down and reorganizing several systems:

Demonblood: Removed

DemonCoin: Removed

Quests, Rune Pages: Removed

Memory Shards: Removed

Certain tactics features: Removed

With these adjustments, we aim to streamline the gameplay and enhance the overall pacing. Next week, we’ll share more details, along with videos and screenshots to give you a closer look at the progress.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog 2: Combat Experiments
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s been another productive week, and we’re back with our weekly devlog update. This week, we’ve been experimenting with potions in the combat system. Early on, we actually had an idea where potions would play a significant role in the combat loop, as you can see in the concept art below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/fe82596288631b620c41ed48b05d11671c521978.png[/img]

In the early concept of RangBi, you can see various items intended for use during combat in the bottom right corner of the screen. At that time, the interface was closer to something like Darkest Dungeon, and we originally planned a grid-based combat system. However, those features were eventually scrapped as the game evolved.

We initially dropped the inventory and potion system due to UI limitations. But now that we have more experience—and a dedicated UI designer—we feel ready to tackle this challenge once again.

Here’s what we've added:

[b]Squad-shared inventory[/b]: This can store various items, along with a hotbar for easier access during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/26715747b57f1d319d3a729a38d53bfab05e366d.png[/img]

[b]Potions: [/b]These offer a variety of buffs when used before battle. There’s even an invisibility potion that lets you hide from enemies!

[b]Targeting system for potions: [/b]You can strategically use potions to affect specific targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/4e22526427e3823004fb9ce389f04264b02461a6.png[/img]

We’ve captured this process in the video below. It’s still a bit rough, and we’re not sure if the feature will make it into the final game.

[previewyoutube=WA3TdgMFUak;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, we’re also exploring another potential feature: changing the combat system to resemble a traditional autobattler. This would introduce a new safe zone where players can strategically deploy their characters, adding more flexibility to the starting phase of each battle. The stealth mechanics would be limited to areas outside the safe zone, which would significantly alter how players approach combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/a6c1ec2ecef856692095aa7af439b094de1c7d6c.png[/img]

Keep in mind, both of these features are experimental and may change in the coming weeks.

That’s all for this week’s update. As always, we welcome your feedback, good or bad. Feel free to reach out to us on Discord or via email.

Thanks for your continued support, and we’ll see you next week for more[b] RangBi[/b] news!

notes.title: Devlog 1
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, Welcome to the first RangBi developper update.

Starting today, we'll aim to share weekly updates about RangBi’s development, our direction for the game, and what new features are in the works. Most updates, like today, will include fresh screenshots of upcoming features, and occasionally we’ll drop some video content as well.

[h1][b]Demo Release[/b][/h1]

First and foremost, we're thrilled to announce that the RangBi demo has been officially released on Steam! After nearly eight months of development, the game is now available to the public.

For us at the RangBi team, this is our first public release, and we’ve learned so much from it. While there were plenty of positives—such as receiving more players and data than expected—we’ve also noticed some challenges. Many of you mentioned that the early game can feel confusing or difficult to grasp, leading some players to quit before reaching the "fun" parts of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/a8f08ad1873f846df401344bf71d861acc345f5c.png[/img]

[b][h1]Runes & Quests[/h1][/b]

One of the major changes we’re working on is revamping the item and quest systems. In the current demo, items can be confusing since they sometimes upgrade character stats and other times boost skills. Additionally, some items are locked behind particularly difficult quests, making it almost impossible to unlock related features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/2b53876ed961e57276a503f77f99f85a2368f39d.png[/img]

We’re addressing this by introducing [b]Rune Pages[/b]. While quests will remain (in fact, a lot more will be added), they’ll now reward [b]Rune Points[/b] based on difficulty. Players will then use these Rune Points to upgrade characters, much like skill trees in traditional RPGs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/58ce2cf12234d7176f6ea24296327940794e85f5.png[/img]

We hope that this will clear up the item-quest confusion and add more depth to RangBi combat.
 

[b][h1]Early game changes[/h1][/b]

We’ve heard your feedback on the early game, and we agree—changes are on the way! Based on player tests and data, we see that players enjoy the game once they understand its mechanics. However, the lack of a strong early-game hook means that many players don’t stick around long enough to experience the real fun.

To address this, we’re working on adding early-game story elements and immersive content that will engage players beyond just combat. This will give players more to explore and enjoy while they naturally learn RangBi's robust combat system.

Plus, we will change that starting screen too, it is long overdue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902338/284e961c188cf66455f15825d73c5dec30ea45bc.png[/img]

That’s all for this week’s update. Stay tuned for more, and as always, feel free to reach out to us via [url=https://discord.gg/vK2bg62m]Discord[/url] or email. We love hearing feedback from players and are always eager to improve the game based on your suggestions!
